title: Intermediate result fullAffineEtale_cohomology_comparison_point
statement: For every scheme S [def-pc-scheme], every affine object U of its full affine etale site [def-weil-pbc-full-affine-etale-site], and Ext structures in a common universe w on the categories of abelian sheaves on both sites [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], there exists a natural additive degree-zero cohomology comparison from the restricted sheaf at U to the original sheaf at its image in the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Under the canonical Ext-zero, sheafification, free-abelian and Yoneda identifications with sections [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], it is the identity on sections: for every abelian sheaf G and every degree-zero class x, the section obtained from the image of x is the section obtained from x.

proof.text: Use Ext.addEquiv₀, sheafificationAdjunction.homAddEquiv, AddCommGrpCat.adj.whiskerRight and yonedaEquiv to identify degree-zero cohomology with sections on both sites. Restriction has the same section groups and map components. Compose the first equivalence with the inverse of the second, and use naturality of the adjunctions and Ext-zero postcomposition to give a natural isomorphism. Its section identity is AddEquiv.apply_symm_apply.

theorem fullAffineEtale_cohomology_comparison_point (S : Scheme.{u})
    [HasExt.{w} (Sheaf (fullAffineEtaleTopology S) AddCommGrpCat.{u})]
    [HasExt.{w} (Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u})]
    (U : S.FullAffineEtale) :
    ∃ e :
      (fullAffineEtaleInclusion S).sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u}
          (fullAffineEtaleTopology S) S.smallEtaleTopology ⋙
        Sheaf.cohomologyPresheafFunctor.{w} (fullAffineEtaleTopology S) 0 ⋙
          (CategoryTheory.evaluation _ _).obj (op U) ≅
      Sheaf.cohomologyPresheafFunctor.{w} S.smallEtaleTopology 0 ⋙
        (CategoryTheory.evaluation _ _).obj (op U.obj),
    ∀ (G : Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u})
      (x : Sheaf.H'.{w}
        (((fullAffineEtaleInclusion S).sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u}
          (fullAffineEtaleTopology S) S.smallEtaleTopology).obj G) 0 U),
      (((sheafificationAdjunction S.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u}).homEquiv _ _
        (Ext.homEquiv₀ ((e.app G).hom x))).app (op U.obj))
          (FreeAbelianGroup.of (𝟙 U.obj)) =
      (((sheafificationAdjunction (fullAffineEtaleTopology S) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).homEquiv
        _ _ (Ext.homEquiv₀ x)).app (op U)) (FreeAbelianGroup.of (𝟙 U))
